questions.text: Each student ID is assigned exactly one homeroom. Several IDs may share a homeroom. Is homeroom a function of student ID?
answers: No: different IDs may have the same homeroom
Yes: any relationship is a function
Yes: each input ID has exactly one output homeroom
No: a function must use numbers for both inputs and outputs
questions.explanation: Repeated outputs are allowed; one input cannot have two different outputs.

questions.text: Two students share a locker. The rule takes a locker number as input and returns every assigned student. Does it define one student as a function of locker number?
answers: No: functions cannot describe school situations
No: one locker input can have two student outputs
Yes: repeated inputs are always allowed to have different outputs
